roster.name: Evidence & Conclusion Ontology (ECO)
roster.description: An ontology (OWL/OBO) for classifying types of scientific evidence and assertion methods used in biological research and biocuration. Defines two top-level classes, 'evidence' and 'assertion method', used to record the type of evidence supporting assertions (e.g., GO annotations). Distributed as eco.owl / eco.obo, includes mappings to Gene Ontology evidence codes, and is released under CC0.
